devices.name: Brunner CLS-E NG Yoke (force feedback, Beechcraft-style handle)

identify.note: Quick install guide: shows up in Windows as game controller «CLSE NG Yoke» (standalone mode); USB X axis = roll, Y axis = pitch. Standalone default: button 1 = trim reset, buttons 4 and 5 = trim, buttons 2 and 3 free. Which of buttons 4/5 is nose up and where each button sits on the handle is not documented (left horn: two red push buttons and a rocker, right horn: a small hat, per the product photo). With CLS2Sim installed the software maps the axes itself. Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.

devices.name: Brunner CLS-E MK II Yoke (force feedback, handle with display)

identify.note: Quick install guide: shows up in Windows as game controller “CLSE MK II Yoke”; USB X axis = roll, Y axis = pitch; Beechcraft-style handle with 5 buttons, a coolie hat and a display. Standalone default: button 1 = trim reset, buttons 4 and 5 = trim, buttons 2, 3 and the coolie hat free. The DirectInput form of the coolie hat (POV or buttons) is not documented. Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.

devices.name: Brunner CLS-E MK II Rudder Pedals (with toe brakes)

identify.note: Quick install guide: shows up in Windows as game controller «CLSE MK II Rudder» (standalone mode); map the Z axis to yaw, X rotation to the left brake and Y rotation to the right brake. With CLS2Sim the USB mapping must be disabled. Not the same product as the 2026 FFB-G Rudder. Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.

devices.name: Brunner CLS-B Rudder Pedals (with toe brakes)

identify.note: Quick install guide (V2, 2026): shows up in Windows as game controller «CLS-B Rudder» (standalone mode); Z axis = yaw, X rotation = left brake, Y rotation = right brake. Fact sheets exist for variants V001 and V003. Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.

devices.name: Brunner CLS-E MK II Heli Rudder Pedals

identify.note: Helicopter version of the CLS-E MK II rudder. The product page links the CLS-E MK II Rudder quick install guide (Z axis = yaw). Its fact sheet repeats 'proportional toe brakes' from the fixed-wing sheet, so whether toe-brake axes exist is not verified; the Windows device name is not stated (probably the same «CLSE MK II Rudder», not used for matching). Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.

devices.name: Brunner CLS-E MK II Joystick A320 (fixed A320 sidestick grip)

identify.note: CLS-E MK II force feedback base with a non-removable A320 sidestick grip (grip variants V002 A3xx pilot / V005 A3xx first officer; captain = left hand, first officer = right hand). Quick install guide: shows up in Windows as a game controller, USB X axis = roll, Y axis = pitch. Grip controls per the product photo: index trigger (radio/PTT) and the red takeover push button on top; their button numbers are not published. Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.

devices.name: Brunner CLS-E MK II Joystick Jet (BRUNNER Jet grip)

identify.note: CLS-E MK II force feedback base delivered with the BRUNNER Jet grip (variant V003). Quick install guide: shows up in Windows as a game controller, USB X axis = roll, Y axis = pitch; in standalone mode (no CLS2Sim) the hat switch is hardware trim. Grip controls per the product photo: top hat, red button left of it, green button right of it, index trigger; button numbers are not published. Brunner's USB vendor id is 25BB (usb.ids: Brunner Elektronik AG); the product id of this model is not published, so no VID:PID is used for matching.
